description: step_condition is an anyOf, so its type is the type declared for the merged anyOf, under the same name, and the definition declares nothing of its own. workflow_step.when refers to it once more through an allOf copy. Once forgotten, the definition was generated again there and declared as an unused StepCondition_1 with a collision warning. (The anyOf mixes object and primitive branches, whose validator does not compile yet; this schema is for name checks only.)
